units.source_text: “我第一次利用暑期回故乡的时候，

en.t: “When I first used the summer vacation to return to my hometown,

units.source_text: 叔叔婶婶已经住进了父母去世后空无一人的老宅中，成了新主人。

en.t: my uncle and aunt had already moved into the old house that had stood empty after my parents died, and had become its new masters.

units.source_text: 这是在我去东京之前就说好的。

en.t: This had been agreed on before I went to Tokyo.

units.source_text: 因为，剩下我一个人，又不在家住，也只能如此了。

en.t: Since I was the only one left and would not be living at home, there was nothing else to be done.

units.source_text: 那时候，叔叔好像跟城里的许多公司都有业务关系。

en.t: At that time, my uncle seemed to have business ties with many companies in town.

units.source_text: 他曾经笑着说，若从去公司上班的角度来说，住在以前的住所，要比搬到相距七八里远的我家来，方便得多。

en.t: He once laughed and said that, from the standpoint of going to work at those companies, living in his former residence was far more convenient than moving to my house, which was seven or eight li away.

units.source_text: 这是父母死后，我跟叔叔商量如何处置房子，去东京求学时，叔叔流露出来的。

en.t: This was something my uncle let slip after my parents died, when I was consulting him about what to do with the house before going to Tokyo to study.

units.source_text: 我家的老宅很有年头了，因此在那一带颇为有名。

en.t: My family's old house had a long history, and for that reason it was fairly well known in the area.
I suppose it is the same in your hometown, too?

units.source_text: 在乡下，倘若有名望的宅子虽有继承人，却被拆掉或卖掉的话，可是件了不得的大事。

en.t: In the countryside, if a distinguished house is torn down or sold even though it has an heir, it is a very serious matter.

units.source_text: 要是搁现在，我当然不觉得有什么难办的，但那时我还是个孩子，

en.t: If it were now, of course I would not think it especially difficult, but at that time I was still a child,

units.source_text: 已经去了东京求学，又要保留宅子，所以为此很是发愁。

en.t: and since I had gone to Tokyo to study while still having to preserve the house, I was greatly troubled over what to do.

units.source_text: 叔叔只好同意搬进我空荡荡的家里。

en.t: My uncle had no choice but to agree to move into my empty house.

units.source_text: 但是他说，如果不让他保留城里的住处，两边住着的话，会很不方便。

en.t: But he said that unless he were allowed to keep his residence in town and live between the two places, it would be very inconvenient.
Of course I had no objection.

units.source_text: 我想的只是，不管什么条件，只要自己能去东京就行。

en.t: All I thought was that any conditions would do, as long as I myself could go to Tokyo.
